{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now compute mean age on the full valid dataset (including refunded orders), but exclude -1 age values
# Because the question asks for 'customers in the sales data' overall, we include all non-QA rows
# But exclude -1 age values as they are invalid
valid_ages_incl_refunded = valid_sales[valid_sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages_incl_refunded['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result and the number of valid customers
print(f"Mean age of customers in the sales data (excluding QA orders and -1 ages): {mean_age}")
print(f"Number of customers included: {len(valid_ages_incl_refunded)}")"}
